_how: Free listings only. for: agency (Open Frame and other service businesses), local (any business with a city), nonprofit (client orgs). The directories loop suggests 2 a month per client that hasn't done or skipped them.

list.name: Google Business Profile
list.why: Shows you in Google Maps and local search, and feeds Google's AI answers.

list.name: Bing Places
list.why: ChatGPT search and Copilot lean on Bing. You can import from Google in one click.

list.name: Apple Business Connect
list.why: Shows you in Apple Maps and Siri answers on iPhones.

list.name: LinkedIn company page
list.why: Where nonprofit staff and boards check who you are.

list.name: Clutch
list.why: Agency directory AI tools often cite for 'best agency for X' questions. Free profile.

list.name: DesignRush
list.why: Agency directory with free listings, often cited in AI answers.

list.name: GoodFirms
list.why: Another agency directory with a free profile.

list.name: Sortlist
list.why: Agency directory strong in Europe, useful for Barcelona.

list.name: Behance
list.why: Portfolio site that ranks well for design searches.

list.name: Dribbble
list.why: Design portfolio, people search it to hire designers.

list.name: Yelp for Business
list.why: Free listing that feeds Apple Maps and many AI answers.

list.name: Candid (GuideStar) profile
list.why: Funders and donors check it. A complete profile earns a transparency seal.

list.name: GreatNonprofits
list.why: Reviews from members and volunteers, often cited in AI answers.

list.name: VolunteerMatch
list.why: Brings in volunteers and adds a trusted mention.

list.name: Idealist
list.why: Free org profile for volunteer and job listings.

list.name: Google for Nonprofits
list.why: Unlocks free Workspace, YouTube nonprofit tools and Ad Grants.
